$comment: Snapshot of the five standard tools exactly as tools/list returns them from https://api.oakallow.io/mcp. Customer-defined and OakGuard gateway tools are per-org and not listed here. Every tool carries _meta.ui.resourceUri, the MCP Apps approval card (ui://oakallow/approval-card).

tools.name: list_my_tools
tools.description: Lists the approved (production) custom tools in the named org (or the account's only org). Tools in draft or testing are not included. Returns each tool's name, description, default permission and risk level.

org.description: The oakallow organization the call targets: its name, or its external id (for example org_oak_…). Required when the account has more than one org; optional when it has exactly one.

tools.name: check_permission
tools.description: Ask whether a given tool call would be allowed, require approval, or be blocked, without actually making the call. Returns the resolved permission verdict and the level it resolved from. Asking about a tool that isn't registered in the org records it there as a draft for an admin to review.

org.description: The oakallow organization the call targets: its name, or its external id (for example org_oak_…). Required when the account has more than one org; optional when it has exactly one.

tools.name: list_pending_approvals
tools.description: For agents and requesters checking on requests they made: lists approval requests made through this connection (the account or agent signed in here) that are still waiting for a decision, across all of your orgs, or only the named org. Requests made by other people or agents, such as a GitHub Actions agent, are not included. When a person asks what is pending or waiting for them to approve, use list_approvals_waiting_for_me instead.

org.description: Optional. An oakallow organization name or external id (for example org_oak_…) to list only that org. Leave it out to list all of your orgs.

tools.name: check_approval_status
tools.description: Returns the status of an approval request by its REF number: pending, approved, denied, expired or cancelled. Covers your own requests and requests made by other members or agents in an org you can act on. Read-only; calling it never creates or changes a request.

reference.description: REF number returned from a prior tool call that required approval.

tools.name: list_approvals_waiting_for_me
tools.description: List approval requests waiting for YOUR decision as an approver: across all of your orgs, or only the named org. Read-only: it never approves or denies anything. A person decides in oakallow with a passkey or another second factor; in chats that show MCP Apps cards, each request appears with Approve and Deny buttons that open oakallow to confirm. Agents cannot decide approvals.

org.description: Optional. An oakallow organization name or external id (for example org_oak_…) to list only that org. Leave it out to list all of your orgs.
